meta.title: Order Medicines - GetMEDS
meta.description: Order your medicines securely with GetMeds. Upload your prescription and get fast delivery to your doorstep.

hero.heading: Order Your Medicines With Ease
hero.description: Simply upload your prescription, fill out the validation form, and our licensed pharmacists will handle the rest. Your health, delivered.

howItWorks.heading: How to Order with Prescription
howItWorks.description: A simple 3-step process designed for your convenience

steps.title: Upload
steps.description: Take a clear photo or upload a digital copy of your valid prescription.

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: Our licensed pharmacists will verify the details within minutes.

steps.title: Confirmation
steps.description: You'll receive a notification once your order is confirmed and ready.

prescriptionGuidance.heading: Prescription Guide
items: Ensure your prescription is from a licensed physician
The prescription must be current and not expired
All medication names, dosages, and quantities must be clearly visible
Your name and the prescribing doctor's details must be present
